titel: Click Joints Pro, galerijbeeld 'From your rig in one click' op Superhive (echt Blender-paneel, 1.2.9)
rol: You make poseable action figures and characters to 3D print at home. You already have a rigged character in Blender (for example from Mixamo) and want a Blender add-on that turns it into printable parts with working joints. You are not a Blender expert and want to know how easy the add-on is to use. You are browsing the Superhive (Blender Market) store and are now looking at the gallery images that show each add-on's panel inside Blender.

ons.naam: paneel met rig, Figure from rig bovenaan
